messages.author: 2f290adf43ab77a1
messages.subject: Rattle freezes on Ubuntu 13 (Mint distribution)
parts:
Hi-

This sequence opens the Rattle window but the window does not respond at all. This is with the latest rattle, 3.3.0.

shell> r
library(rattle)
Rattle: A free graphical interface for data mining with R.
Version 3.3.1 Copyright (c) 2006-2014 Togaware Pty Ltd.
Type 'rattle()' to shake, rattle, and roll your data.

rattle()

--------


This is the R version from the Ubuntu package set:
shell> r --version
r ('littler') version 0.1.5
svn revision 185 as of 2011-09-17 09:35:56
built at 09:13:01 on Oct 31 2011
using GNU R Version 2.13.2 (2011-09-30)

I just now installed R and some libraries. The R Commander program works, so it's not a general R problem. What could be the problem? 

Thanks,

Lance Norskog

messages.author: 51ea28fc190ac537
messages.subject: Re: Rattle freezes on Ubuntu 13 (Mint distribution)
parts:
This looks like you are trying to run littler interactively. littler is meant for scripting. Try "big" R.

shell> R
library(rattle)
rattle()

Regards,
Graham
